claims.text: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy is built into the API server (in-process, stable since 1.30) in Kubernetes 1.34; no webhook or extra component is installed to use it.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Reference > API Access Control > Validating Admission Policy (feature-state stable v1.30; 'declarative, in-process alternative to validating admission webhooks')

claims.text: A policy's validations are CEL expressions; an expression evaluating to false is a validation failure, and the request passes only if every expression is true.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Validating Admission Policy, 'Creating a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy' (spec.validations)

claims.text: CEL expressions return a value (here true/false), are not Turing complete and cannot loop forever; Kubernetes bounds their evaluation cost.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Reference > Using Common Expression Language in Kubernetes ('CEL ... not Turing complete', resource constraints)

claims.text: A policy has effect only with a ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding, which names it (policyName), scopes it (matchResources) and sets validationActions: Deny refuses, Warn returns a warning to the client, Audit adds the failure to the request's audit event.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Validating Admission Policy, 'What Resources Make a Policy', 'Validation actions'

claims.text: With Deny, a failing request is refused with an error containing the validation's message and nothing is stored; with Warn the object is stored and the client receives a warning.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Validating Admission Policy, 'Validation actions' and example denial message; outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/admission-policy.txt

claims.text: Admission checks requests that create, update or delete an object (dry-run included) before it is stored, never reads; a new policy or binding does not evaluate or stop objects already stored, such as running Pods.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Admission Control in Kubernetes ('admission controllers ... intercept requests ... prior to persistence'; do not act on reads); Validating Admission Policy matchConstraints operations

claims.text: CEL in a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy reads only variables the API server provides (object, oldObject, request, params, namespaceObject, authorizer); it cannot contact a registry or other outside system, so it cannot check what a digest points to or its signature.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Validating Admission Policy, 'Validation expression' (available variables)

claims.text: An admission webhook is an HTTPS server outside the API server that the API server calls during admission; validating webhooks approve or refuse, mutating webhooks can change the object; a webhook can run any code.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Dynamic Admission Control (What are admission webhooks?; webhook served over HTTPS)

claims.text: Webhook failurePolicy: Fail rejects the request when calling the webhook errors (unreachable, timeout, bad response); Ignore lets the request continue unchecked.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Dynamic Admission Control, 'Failure policy'

claims.text: A ValidatingAdmissionPolicy's own failurePolicy governs misconfiguration and CEL evaluation errors in the policy, not a false expression; with Fail such an error is enforced by validationActions (here Deny, so refused).
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Validating Admission Policy, 'Failure Policy' and 'Validation actions' last paragraph
